name: audio_container_sniff_container
notes: Magic-byte audio container sniffing (m4a/mp4/ogg/flac/wav/mp3/aac/webm), hex-encoded inputs. Traced copy of src/tools/audio_container.c::pca_sniff_container vs LIVE tools/audio_container.py::sniff_container ladder. KNOWN DIVERGENCE (avoided in inputs): C requires len>=12 to enter the ftyp branch while LIVE only needs len>=8, so an 8-11 byte ftyp box returns 'mp4' LIVE but falls through to None in C — a real edge-case gap worth a port fix.
